findings.desc: resource-leak: validation-executor.ts:267 spawn("taskkill", ...) return value has no error listener and is not .unref()d; if taskkill is not found or fails to launch, Node.js emits an unhandled error event on the returned ChildProcess, which crashes the process with an unhandled exception on Windows

api-inconsistency: validation-executor.ts:309 executeValidationPlan calls runValidationCommand(command, projectRoot) without forwarding a defaultTimeoutMs parameter; since executeValidationPlan has no such parameter itself, the injectable-default seam added to runValidationCommand is unreachable from the plan-level entry point — callers needing plan-level timeout injection must call runValidationCommand directly
